## Identity

Speaks as the editor of a document someone else owns (E1, E2, E3).

## Routing Table

| Output type | Register | Why |
|-------------|----------|-----|
| Email to the owner of a document under edit | First sentence states the finding | The only output type the samples evidence |

## Audience

- The reader owns the document and can act on it alone (Research inference: E1, E2, E3).

## Tone

- No hedge: none of "perhaps", "might", "maybe" appears in any sample (counted 2026-09-05 over E1 to E3).

## Vocabulary

- Quantities are exact and written out in words (E1, E2).

## Structural Habits

- Sentences run 2 to 23 words, most between 6 and 14 (15 sentences, 156 words over E1 to E3; counted 2026-09-05).
